name: ashlar/process
title: How it works
description: The process in plain English, step by step: tabs on desktop and an accordion on mobile. Each step says what the client does, what you do, what they get and what they pay.

lede.default: Here’s a typical rear extension, from the first visit to the day we hand it over, with what we’ll need from you along the way and when each payment is due.

helpLink.default: Ring Marta on 020 7946 0321 and she’ll talk you through it

default.label: We visit
default.title: We come and see your house
default.lede: We come round for an hour, free, and ask a lot of questions about how you live and what’s driving you mad about the house. If you want to go ahead, we come back and measure everything properly.
youDo: Tell us what you want and roughly what you can spend
Show us the bits that annoy you about the house
weDo: Measure everything and check the structure
Tell you honestly if it needs planning permission
default.youGet: A written brief and survey drawings
default.youPay: First visit free. Survey £950, taken off your build if you go ahead.

default.label: Fixed price
default.title: You get one fixed price
default.lede: We draw it up with your architect, or ours, and Priya prices it line by line, so you can see exactly where the money goes before you sign anything.
youDo: Pick finishes from a short, sensible list
Approve the drawings when you are happy
weDo: Price every item, line by line
Plan the build week by week and give you a start date
default.youGet: Fixed price, start date and a week-by-week plan
default.youPay: 10% deposit to book your start date.

default.label: We build
default.title: We build
default.lede: One site manager runs your job from the first day to the last, and you get their mobile number.
youDo: Answer the odd decision, always with a deadline
weDo: Run the site and keep it tidy every day
Price any change in writing before we do it
default.youGet: A report every Friday, with photos
default.youPay: Monthly, only for work that is already done.

default.label: Keys
default.title: You get your keys
default.lede: We walk round the finished house with you and write down anything that isn’t right, down to a sticky drawer. Then we come back and fix the lot.
youDo: Walk round with us and point out anything you spot
weDo: Fix every snag within 10 working days
Hand over certificates and a manual for your house
default.youGet: Keys, building control sign-off, house manual
default.youPay: Final payment, minus 2.5% we hold until every snag is fixed.

default.label: Aftercare
default.title: We’re still around for ten years
default.lede: We ring you at six months and again at a year to ask how the house is behaving. If anything structural goes wrong in the next ten years, we come back and fix it.
youDo: Call us if something doesn’t feel right
weDo: Fix anything structural, at our cost
